{{Top|leg}}
'''Osaji Uhares''' was a member of the [[Osaji family]], who worked for the family business, the [[Osaji Syndicate]]. He lived on [[Centares/Legends|Centares]], had a [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetic]] hand and collected old [[Droid/Legends|droids]]. He refitted twelve [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]]s and a [[Droideka/Legends|Droideka]] to serve as his personal [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguards]]. He was [[Death/Legends|killed]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] by a group of [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] hired by Uhares's sister, [[Osaji Hux]].
